instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Strato Digital is a specialized engineering design consultancy providing comprehensive structural, MEP, and sustainability consulting services for large-scale commercial real estate and critical infrastructure projects. The team leverages advanced tools like Revit and IES VE to perform complex building performance simulations, focusing on optimizing material use and reducing lifecycle costs across global projects.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is embedded in our operating rhythm through structured quarterly hackathons and a formal patent portfolio. The 'innovation fellow' program facilitates deep exploratory work, exemplified by the recent successful prototype for automated quality inspection using computer vision that reduced defect escape rates by 35% in pilot projects.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and shifting consumer demands; therefore, we must move beyond incremental improvements to identify entirely new value propositions. We aim to leverage our core engineering brand in adjacent markets like predictive maintenance consulting or niche sustainability compliance auditing where demand is growing.
answers.additionalContext: Strato Digital is currently positioned as a niche expert but lacks the internal scale and dedicated technical team required to rapidly pivot into adjacent, technology-heavy service sectors.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Predictive Maintenance Consulting Arm
opportunities.rationale: Leverage existing structural data and simulation expertise to offer high-margin predictive maintenance consulting services for aging infrastructure clients.

first_actions: Identify three target large infrastructure clients with known asset health issues.
Develop a Minimum Viable Service (MVS) proposal focused on structural risk modeling.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Cloud computing subscription for simulation data processing
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 2 pilot consulting contracts within the next 6 months.
milestones: Q1: MVS development and pricing strategy finalized

opportunities.title: Generative Design SaaS Productization
opportunities.rationale: Package proprietary computational design workflows (Revit/IES VE setups) into a low-code SaaS product accessible to smaller, regional firms.

first_actions: Define the core 'optimization engine' features for the MVP.
Conduct beta testing with five small boutique engineering firms.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 10 paying SaaS subscriptions by end of year.
milestones: Q2: MVP launch and initial paid user acquisition
Q3: Feature expansion based on customer feedback

opportunities.title: Niche Sustainability Compliance Automation Platform
opportunities.rationale: Develop an automated auditing tool specifically targeting complex, regional carbon emission compliance reporting for mid-sized developers.

first_actions: Conduct deep market research on specific state/regional compliance loopholes.
Acquire necessary regulatory expertise through short-term contract.
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure partnership with one major local developer for pilot compliance auditing.
milestones: Q3: Successful high-value pilot project completion

next_steps.action: Commission a feasibility study and detailed business case for the AI-Driven Predictive Maintenance arm.
Allocate 5% of the operational budget specifically to hiring an external Data Science consultant.

key_weaknesses: Severe reliance on founder-led decision-making, creating bottlenecks in scaling radical initiatives.
Lack of specialized in-house talent in data science and advanced AI required for modern diversification efforts.
Limited capital reserves (12% budget) restricts the ability to fund high-risk, long-duration R&D needed for truly radical shifts.
Formal process is too slow for 'short' time horizon strategic goals.
